notes.title: Wartune Reborn Lion King's Trial Events
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627969/3bdc28286fe84a6004bd7f3e86f86694aa438736.jpg[/img]

Hello there, Wartune Reborn special event Lion King's Trial is online now! It's time to gain the Lion King's power by obtaining its limited clothing and mount! 😊
Log in to the game to find out more! 

[b]📌 [In-Game Events][/b]
1. Lion King's Trial Limited Exchange
◆ NEW clothing – Lion King's Outfit
◆ NEW mount – Iron Lion King
◆ Other Clothing: Jungle Goddess Outfit, Flaming Outfit
◆ Other Mounts: Void Dragon, Holy Light Lion

2. Lion King's Trial Lucky Exchange
Try your luck to obtain the rare item – Gift of God!

3. Super Check-In
Activate the Super Check-In Card to claim daily rewards for up to 7 days!

4. Limited-Time Gift Pile
Lion King's Gifts have been scattered around the Cloud City. Don't forget to complete your 30 daily collection attempts. Medal of Lion and other rewards are waiting for you!

Log into the game to find more excitement in Wartune Reborn. Follow our [url=https://www.facebook.com/permalink.php?story_fbid=pfbid0ieqM6rFDxVcfNcsf4VUJHfyhyLaSQdaUPRpn2VZcFSW5ueH2Za98iJoTBDENhvFyl&id=100063484423791]Facebook[/url] to stay tuned!

notes.title: Wartune Reborn New Patch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627969/5c223ce003090b245827a43f496d95886814863b.jpg[/img]

Wartune Reborn New Patch has been officially released after the maintenance on Wednesday, the 1st of March at 01:00 AM PST. It's time to embark on a new journey.

Patch Notes:
1. Defend Sylph Atoll: Sylph Atoll got corrupted by the evil power of the Void Abyss. Conquer those riotous Sylphs and the BOSS to return peace to the area!

2. Sylph Equipment: With more strong enemies emerging on your journey, getting Sylph Equipment and cultivating them will be of significant help!

3. Class Wars Shop Update: 3 all-new mounts have been added to the shop. Fight to earn more Glory Crystal to exchange for them!

Find more excitement in Wartune Reborn!

notes.title: Wartune Reborn Easter Events!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627969/e6ca6383482ba7db1da5e859ae53a7f701dd5327.jpg[/img]

Dear lords, Easter is around the corner! Wartune Reborn Easter events have already started! Log into the game and see!

[In-game Events]
1. New Event: Lucky Exchange will be online during 16th - 20th April. Come on time and use Easter Bunny to try your luck to get the whole new standing mount - Easter Float! Easter Clothing, Easter title and other amazing rewards are also waiting for you!
2. Hot Events: The Easter gift bringer is bringing her gifts to you! Collect Easter items and exchange for the exclusive Easter Gift mount!
3. Fishing & Jewelry Hunt - The most popular Fishing and Jewelry Hunt will be open during 12th-14th February. Participate in time to get abundant benefits!
4. High-Speed Level Up - Experience high speed level up by Double EXP and Bounty Quest+10!

[url=https://www.facebook.com/permalink.php?story_fbid=483456246859479&id=109460747592366][FB Event][/url]
What is your plan to celebrate Easter? Share with us in the comment and 10 of you will win Easter Chest*10 and Easter Bunny*10! (Event ends on 17th April) 

Happy Easter! May your life be full of blessings!

Log into the game to find more excitement in Wartune Reborn.

notes.title: Wartune Reborn New Patch Launch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39627969/747ca64a872cbddf2f8caf51254afe3b934c8972.jpg[/img]

[b]Marriage is launched. Marry the one you love！[/b]
ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː[b]MARRIAGE[/b] will be officially launched for all servers on Wednesday, the 16th of July at 01:00 AM PDT!

Patch Note:
ːsteamthisː1. Marriage Feature: Cloud City is filled with new couples and immense love. Come to the sacred church with the one you love and let your love witnessed by the whole world! The ring of pure love will bring you extraordinary love skills!
ːsteamthisː2. Huge Benefit: Epic discount on price of unlocking inventory spaces!
ːsteamthisː3. Amethyst War - Shop Update: Mining? Oh! You must choose Goblin technology! Time is money, my friend!
ːsteamthisː4. Class War - Shop Update: The holy spirit beasts of Gods are coming! They will meet you at Class War on June 24th!
ːsteamthisː5. More Mounts: The owner of Blacksmith has brought more amazing mounts for you to find out!
ːsteamthisː6. Battleground Match Rule: The match rule of Battleground is optimized.
ːsteamthisː7. Social related functions are optimized.
ːsteamthisː8. Uncollected Balens reward in Treasure Lode will be sent via mail automatically.
ːsteamthisː9. Updated description for certain items.
ːsteamthisː10. Modified some translations.
ːsteamthumbsupː11.New server [S90] will be online at 5:00 AM on June 17th!
